_note: Demo crew for the shared console. Roles only, no real people. The console holds every crewmember's readings; each person taps their name to use it, and consoleOwnerId is who is selected when nobody has chosen yet. There is no password: code running in a browser cannot keep a secret. Privacy comes from what is shown: crewmates see only a status word, and opening a full record in an emergency is logged. The demo values below are demo parameters that make the crew board show one critical and one overdue crewmember.
